model: snmpd on Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm), with lldpd 1.0.16 as AgentX subagent

capture.image: debian:12 (+ apt: snmpd snmp lldpd iproute2)
capture.agentConfig: agentAddress udp:161; rocommunity <community> default; rouser fxlabv3 priv; createUser fxlabv3 SHA <authPassphrase> AES <privPassphrase>; sysLocation OpenMap container lab, rack B; sysContact noc@lab.openmap.test; master agentx. lldpd -x on eth0 and swp1; swp1 is a veth to a peer network namespace running a second lldpd (system name lab-peer-sw01), so lldpRemTable holds a real neighbour.

files.name: v2c.walk
files.description: snmpbulkwalk -On output over SNMPv2c for every subtree the collector reads (system, ifTable, ifXTable, ipAddrTable, ipNetToMediaTable, ENTITY-MIB, BRIDGE/Q-BRIDGE, LLDP local and remote, UPS-MIB, ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB); absent MIBs answer noSuchObject

files.name: v3.walk
files.description: the same walk over SNMPv3 authPriv (SHA / AES-128), user fxlabv3

redactions.what: v2c community string in the documented command and agent config (never present in the walk output)
v3 authentication and privacy passphrases in the documented command and agent config (never present in the walk output)

notes: Container agent: interface MACs are Docker-assigned locally administered addresses, addresses are on the private lab bridge, there is no ENTITY-MIB serial. Validated live as well: the snmp collector binary (gosnmp) walked both lab agents over v2c and v3 authPriv with status success.
